scope: 100 C2 newly sealed cases only; complete expected-field semantic audit and new versioned copies; no parser evaluation

label_comparison_contract.fields: Every expected_* field, all *_exclusive flags, execution_allowed and protected_spans; exact JSON-value comparison. No independently authored value changed to fit original labels.
label_comparison_contract.outcome_precedence: New AMBIGUOUS decision => CASE_RECLASSIFIED_AS_INTENTIONALLY_AMBIGUOUS; otherwise any expected-field difference => LABEL_REVISED; otherwise LABEL_CONFIRMED. Query rewrite/removal outcomes are zero because none were authored.
label_comparison_contract.independent_author_outcome_interpretatio: LABEL_CONFIRMED records that the sanitized wording has a complete, unambiguous normative interpretation without query changes. It does not assert agreement with original labels, which remain unseen.
label_comparison_contract.unmentioned_sort_contract: The frozen semantic author specifies RELEVANCE as default. This is recorded as a label-policy resolution, not inferred from current production behavior.
label_comparison_contract.protected_span_convention: Protected spans include both quote delimiters and their literal contents; end offsets are exclusive.

preparation_and_machine_assembly.corrective_action: Fresh independent semantic author received only query-only sanitized input plus enum/schema contract. The preparer did not supply semantic revisions or prior findings to that author. Original gold was machine-compared only after authorship freeze.
